title: Sensory Detect (General Skill, level 20)
body:
Syntax: sensory detect [on|off] | perform sensory detect [on|off]
All classes learn this skill at level 20; teacher practice is required first. Activation costs 20 Chakra; cooldown 15 seconds. Duration is 60 seconds plus mastery percent. While active, you can see, scan, track and target camouflaged ninja, and notice their silent walking. Costs 1 Chakra per second and ends when upkeep cannot be paid. This is an automatic counter while active: repeating look does not reroll detection. It does not reveal immortal invisibility or negate Hidden Mist. Use aff for its remaining duration.
